answer: Run each epoch as a single-elimination tournament: identities are paired at random and must solve a fresh task better than their opponent to advance, and only the bracket winner reaches the zenith payout. Entry costs one copper token, non-refundable, and each identity holds a single ivory pass that cannot be transferred or shared. A farm entering a hundred clones pays a hundred copper tokens, yet its clones mostly eliminate each other in early rounds, so at most one reaches the zenith; multiplying identities multiplies entry cost without multiplying winners.
